subject: Tooling bundling options evaluation — pricing scenarios & pilot ask
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@softwarebroker.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tooling bundling options evaluation — pricing scenarios & pilot ask

Team —

I've pulled the first-pass quotes from the vendors and Samir has put together a short comparison. High level: GHE is offering a 12-month ELA with a 10% discount for committed seats; JetBrains is pushing a small pilot for 3 months to validate seat usage before a bigger commitment; Atlassian provided a modular offer with optional Confluence performance add-on at an incremental cost.

Objectives for this thread:
- Decide whether we pursue a bundled negotiation (single negotiation through Samir) vs vendor-by-vendor.
- Agree on a pilot scope (which teams, target metrics).
- Lock target negotiation asks (audit log retention, SSO + Okta SCIM support, annual true-up window).

Please review the attached spreads. My recommended path is Option C (hybrid bundling): ask for a bundled master agreement that preserves per-vendor product SLAs but buys cross-vendor billing and a single contracting cadence (to simplify finance). The ask to the vendors would be: 8–12 month committed seats for a 12% blended discount plus free migration consulting hours (30).

I want to set a decision sync for Wednesday 16th at 10:00am PT — please confirm availability.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim

+1 to the hybrid approach for operational simplicity. A few notes from Eng: 
- We need guarantee on audit log retention for at least 13 months (security review).
- Any JetBrains pilot must include seat-level usage export (CSV/API) so we can verify drift before committing.
- If we go bundled, make sure billing supports line-item export per product per team — finance will not accept opaque invoices.

I can pull estimated team-by-team seat counts if you want — sending a small table by EOD.

Thanks Rachel — a couple procurement/finance constraints to flag before we lock a cadence: 
- We need a quarterly true-up window (not annual) for any pilot-to-ELA transition to limit surprise charges.
- For bundled billing, Treasury requires a single PO per vendor per quarter (so the broker needs to provide vendor-level invoices).
- Please ensure license migration credits are explicit (we still have ~120 legacy JetBrains perpetual licenses on old terms).

Marissa — can you surface any outstanding SSO/SCIM gaps from your side? If the pilots don't cover SCIM provisioning we should treat that as a blocker.

Subject: Re: Tooling bundling options evaluation — pricing scenarios & pilot ask

Looping the vendors in with a short ask set so we have a common starting point. Vendors — thanks for the initial proposals. For alignment, our baseline asks are below; please reply with whether these can be included in a bundled master agreement or only in vendor-specific terms.

Baseline asks (we expect written confirmation):
1) Audit log retention: 13 months, immutable export (S3-compatible).
2) SSO/SCIM: Okta SCIM provisioning + SP-initiated SSO, rollout support for up to 8 teams.
3) Migration credits: explicit credit for legacy seat migration (JetBrains perpetuals).
4) Billing: single consolidated master invoice + vendor-level line items per quarter.
5) Break/glide path: 90-day notice and prorated refunds for downgrades in year 1.

Pilot ask: JetBrains — a 3-month mini-pilot for 200 seats with seat-usage export and 20 consulting hours included. GitHub — 6-week pilot covering two infra teams (approx 40 seats) to validate code-hosting SSO + audit configurations. Atlassian — module switch trial for Confluence performance add-on for the Platform team (30 pages, load test).

Please respond with written confirmations or redlines by EOD Thursday 17 June. Rachel, Ben, Laura — if you want different timeboxes for pilots, speak now.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Manager, Platform Partnerships (on behalf of Product Security)
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Hi Marissa / team —

Thanks for the clear asks. From GitHub's side: we can confirm the following at high level and can put firm language into a bundled master agreement via Samir's broker channel: 
- Audit logs: 13-month retention with immutable exports to s3 (we'll supply a signed appendix).
- SSO: Okta SCIM + SP-initiated SSO supported; professional services (10 hours) included for setup.
- Billing: we can support consolidated invoicing by arrangement (will require billing contact form).
- Pilot: 6-week sandbox for two infra teams — we'll provide usage export (CSV) and one migration engineer for 15 hours.

We will follow up with Samir for contract language and a preliminary bundled draft. If the team wants, I can join Wed 16th 10am PT but I note that our legal lead isn't available until later that day; we could scope commercial terms now and attach legal appendices after.

Best,
Oliver Park
Enterprise Sales, GitHub
